content.tldr: Agentic RAG uses an iterative reasoning loop to decompose multi-hop questions, while GraphRAG traverses structured knowledge graphs to synthesize global cross-document themes.
content.simple_explanation: Traditional RAG performs a single static retrieval pass, which collapses when questions require multi-hop reasoning across disparate documents or broad thematic summaries. Agentic RAG gives the model autonomous tool-calling access to search, evaluate retrieved context, formulate follow-up queries, and self-correct. GraphRAG extracts entities and relationships into a knowledge graph, enabling community-detection summarization across the entire corpus.
content.real_world_example: Comparing financial statements across 10 annual reports: traditional RAG grabs 5 isolated chunks and hallucinates connections; GraphRAG traverses the corporate relationship graph, while Agentic RAG iteratively queries each year's filing.
content.why_it_matters_and_pitfalls: Agentic RAG increases token consumption and latency exponentially due to multiple sequential LLM calls. Graph construction requires significant upfront extraction compute. Use them for complex analytical queries, not simple point-in-time lookups.
